The '''''Crumb Bomber''''' was the name of an [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]] that served as [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] lead [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Design==
[[File:CrumbBomber_GoF.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The ''Crumb Bomber'']]
Its nose art featured a [[Kowakian monkey-lizard/Legends|Kowakian monkey-lizard]] wielding a bomb, with the inscription ''"Laugh This Off"'' in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]].

==History==
===Battle of Teth===
The ''Crumb Bomber'' was seen in the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]] and was stationed on the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']] during the hunt for the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']].<ref name="Shadow">{{TCW|Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref><ref name="TCWEGSM">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode003.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref>

===Battle of the Rishi Moon===
During the [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|Battle of the Rishi moon]], the ''Crumb Bomber'' was used to rescue surviving clone troopers after the destruction of the [[Rishi Station/Legends|outpost]].<ref name="TCWEGR">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode005.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Rookies}}</ref>

===Battle of Ryloth===
''Crumb Bomber'' was also used to land [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|troops]] on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] to [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|retake Ryloth]] from [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces and was used by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to land on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth's]] surface.

==Behind the scenes==
In the "[[Innocents of Ryloth]]" Episode Guide, the trivia states that the ''Crumb Bomber'' was Obi-Wan Kenobi's lead gunship.

The nose art on the ''Crumb Bomber'' is similar to the work seen on World War II bombers.
[[File:Kowakian_mascot.jpg|thumb|right|180px|The Crumb Bomber logo]]

The nose art on a LEGO Gunship uses this design.
